script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. The Sun conjunct Venus lights up your 7th House of Partnerships, while Jupiter, your traditional ruler, trines Saturn in your 1st House from your 9th House of Travel. Yet stern Saturn squares the Sun from your 1st House of Self and identity. If single, a foreign connection sparks through this celestial pull, so check your inbox immediately now. For those committed, guard against overpromising romance during this dangerously high Venus energy surge. In your career, Saturn in the 10th House rewards structure; sign that promotion but verify every single clause carefully. Watch out: charm might hide a hidden agenda in serious business talks. Your water-sign intuition will guide a quiet breakthrough via old contacts. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss another big cosmic shift now.
